title: After-Hours Dispatch Cost Recovery on Unclosed Listings — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
**Schedule.** On a failed sale of a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order, Bridgewell recovers an after-hours dispatch cost: the listing's after-hours rate times the number of emergency requests the seller placed in the seller phase, rounded to the cent. The cost is added to the lesser of the failed-sale charge cap and the seller-phase benefit paid, and the charge so formed is floored at zero.

| Emergency requests the seller placed in the seller phase of the order | After-hours rate |
|---|---|
| at least one of them in the hvac trade | $95.00 per emergency seller-phase request — the costliest after-hours dispatch |
| one or more, none of them in the hvac trade | $70.00 per emergency seller-phase request |
| none | no after-hours dispatch cost |

The rate, once set, applies to every emergency request the seller placed in the seller phase, whatever its trade. Routine requests are not counted.

## Records read

The seller-phase service requests on the order: their urgency (emergency or routine) and their trade.

## Illustrations (hypothetical listings)

| Seller-phase requests on the order | Rate | After-hours dispatch cost |
|---|---|---|
| 3 emergency requests, one of them hvac | $95.00 | 3 times $95.00: $285.00 |
| 2 emergency plumbing requests | $70.00 | 2 times $70.00: $140.00 |
| 1 emergency hvac request and 2 routine requests | $95.00 | 1 times $95.00: $95.00 |
| routine requests only | — | none |
